# Third party files in this folder

- `preact-htm.js` is Preact (MIT, https://preactjs.com) and htm (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/developit/htm) in one
  file, as published by htm at `htm/preact/standalone.module.js` (version 3.1.1). It is used as it comes, with no build step.
- The icons in `../js/icons.js` are from Tabler Icons (MIT, https://tabler.io/icons).
- `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` and `xterm-addon-fit.js` are xterm.js 6.0.0 and its fit addon 0.11.0 (MIT, https://xtermjs.org), as published on npm
  (`@xterm/xterm`, `@xterm/addon-fit`, the files `lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css` and `lib/addon-fit.js`). They draw the terminal of the
  ssh window.
